content:
**A reason is not said until the last layer says it (#882)**

Three separate rounds of the #882 tracker review found the same shape: a value explaining an absence exists in the data and never reaches the page, because an intermediate layer builds its own object and does not copy the field. Carrying the reason is not enough; every layer between the reader and the renderer has to pass it.
